Current snapshot must be fresh and exactly same task/version/auth epoch; bounded<=128 workers; exactly one actionRef+actionDigest match. Explicit foreign taskRef rejects. Full refs and checked safe phase required; only intent/submitted normalize to unknown. No session/claim/generation fabricated.
Query captures frozen projected requested mapping from current task detail before send; result must match all7 original identity fields. No ambiguous/missing/malformed/foreign adoption.
canQuery exposes same readonly zero-effect predicate for Query role facts button; named auditQuery remains sole stale run exception, preserving stale/uncertainty/no consent.
create remains blocked while uncertain dispatchAudit; no retry, create,execute,capture,grant,permit,settlement or provider effects. Original host query authority remains unchanged.

Disconnect preserves existing uncertain operation; if dispatchAudit or executeAudit was pending, captures that exact operation as uncertain before epoch/revision abort. Late response cannot clear the marker.

execute refuses both unknown dispatchAudit and executeAudit; successful query never clears uncertainty or grants execution/retry. Explicit native factual reconciliation remains separately defined, not guessed.
